financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Registered direct offering of 15,000,000 shares with accompanying common warrants, closed Sept 25, 2023
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: We estimate the net proceeds from this offering will be approximately $4.0 million, after deducting fees payable to financial advisors and other estimated offering expenses payable by us.

warrants.quote: The March 2023 Common Warrants have an exercise price of $0.60 per share of common stock, will be exercisable beginning on September 11, 2023 and will expire on September 10, 2028.
The March 2023 Pre-Funded Warrants were exercisable immediately upon issuance and have an exercise price of $0.001 per share of common stock.

The Common Warrants have an exercise price of $0.325 and, subject to certain ownership limitations described herein, are exercisable immediately upon issuance, will expire on the date that is five years following the date of issuance
